question: Which state launched the 'Divyang Sahayak Portal', India's first AI-enabled one-stop digital platform for disability welfare schemes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the 'Divyang Sahayak Portal', making Maharashtra the first state to launch such an integrated platform.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Divyang Sahayak Portal is an AI-enabled, paperless platform designed to streamline access to welfare schemes for persons with disabilities (PwDs).**
 
• It integrates **UDID (Unique Disability ID)** and Aadhaar to enable end-to-end online delivery of services.
 
• The portal covers **21 disability categories** as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
 
• Features include real-time application tracking, automatic approvals, and an AI-based grievance redressal system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• RPwD Act, 2016__

 __
 
• Significance - It increased the number of recognized disabilities from 7 to 21 and reserved 4% of government jobs for PwDs.
 
 
 
• UDID Card__
 __
 
• Project - "Unique ID for Persons with Disabilities" project is being implemented with a view of creating a National Database for PwDs.
 
 
 
• Divyang Kalyan Department__
 
 
• Context - Maharashtra was also the first state in India to establish a separate 'Divyang Kalyan Department' (Department of Disability Welfare) in 2022.
